description: Ministry of Lands - Appointed Mr. D. M. Somarathna to expedite the Land acquisition for Road Development Projects under R.D.A. Appointed Mr. A. P. P. de Vas Gunawardana & Mr. Ariyarathne to expedite the Land acquisition for Southern Expressway Projects (Southern Section) under R.D.A. Appointed Mr. S. M. L. B. Samarakoon to expedite the Land acquisition for Moragahakanda Kaluganga Development Projects
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically appoints officers to handle land acquisition duties for various development projects (Road Development Projects, Southern Expressway Project, Moragahakanda Kaluganga Development Project). While it does mention a government minister making the appointments, the core subject matter is land acquisition and property matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4). The appointments are specifically for land-related duties rather than general government personnel changes.
